title: Trombone stylists: Dorsey, Wells, Higginbotham, Trummy Young
summary: Asked who set trombone styles, Durham discusses Tommy Dorsey's sweet tone, Dicky Wells, J.C. Higginbotham and Trummy Young, who he thinks was buried.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how
